description:
Refactor the legacy `BeamSetup` class from a standard POJO to a Java 17 Record in the `RadiationTherapy` project.

Your task:
1. Open the `RadiationTherapy` project in Eclipse (located in `~/eclipse-workspace/RadiationTherapy`).
2. Convert `src/main/java/com/medsys/rt/model/BeamSetup.java` into a `public record`.
3. Ensure you preserve the constructor validation logic (gantry angle must be 0-360).
4. Update `src/main/java/com/medsys/rt/service/TreatmentPlan.java` to fix compilation errors caused by the change (records use fluent accessors like `beamId()` instead of `getBeamId()`).
5. Run the existing JUnit tests (`BeamSetupTest.java`) to verify the refactoring.
6. Ensure the project compiles and all tests pass.
